title: Add schema write controls without posting set

costar.context: Dashboard metrics parse a real frame and do not invent numbers. Schema writes are the next remaining portal surface. The maintainer's goal forbids posting a set against this server.
costar.objective: Add create, save, and delete confirmation from the portal sentences, build the registry set call, and do not send it.
costar.style: One plan, then the write controls.
costar.response: Delete asks for confirmation with the portal sentence. Save reports no changes. Nothing posts x:Object/set.

concerns: A set response confirms a change through created, updated, or destroyed. An empty response is not a confirmation.
Singletons cannot be destroyed. The delete control stays off those views.
The form is still readonly, so Save has no edits to send.
context: The list says Create {{name}}, Delete {{name}}?, and Are you sure you want to delete {{label}}? This action cannot be undone. The form says This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete this {{name}}. Save, Cancel, No changes to save, and The server did not confirm the change. Registry set takes create, update, and destroy.
current_state: Create, Save, and the delete confirmation render from the portal sentences. registrySet builds create, update, and destroy. The route does not post it. Save says there are no changes.
target_design: WriteActions uses bits-ui AlertDialog for delete. A pure registrySet builds the method call. The route does not call it. Save says there are no changes. Confirming delete says the server did not confirm the change.
changes: Add the write sentences and the set call shape.
Render create, save, and the delete confirmation.
Keep the route from posting set.
boundaries: Do not post a set, a delivery, or an action.
Do not turn the readonly input into a typed widget.

verification.name: writes-do-not-post
verification.proves: The set call matches create, update, and destroy. An empty response is not confirmed. The confirmation sentences render, and the route does not post set.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The write controls and the alert dialog typecheck.
